[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. **Classic Basil Pesto**: 1 cup fresh basil, 1/2 cup pine nuts, 1/2 cup vegan parmesan, 1/2 cup olive oil, 2 cloves garlic, salt.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. **Spinach and Pumpkin Seed Pesto**: 1 cup spinach, 1/2 cup pumpkin seeds, 1/2 cup vegan parmesan, 1/2 cup olive oil, 2 cloves garlic, salt.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. **Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto**: 1 cup sun-dried tomatoes, 1/2 cup cashews, 1/2 cup vegan parmesan, 1/4 cup olive oil, 2 cloves garlic, salt.
